spec.subject: Compact rangefinder-style digital camera (left-grip, right-offset lens)

visual_goal.description: A compact, boxy rangefinder-style camera with a right-offset lens, a left-only tactile grip, two top dials and a centered hot shoe, plus a small optical viewfinder window at the top-right of the front and a right-side port door.
signature_features: Centered ISO-518 style hot shoe on top plate
Front viewfinder window at top-right (per reference)

issues.observed: Proportions seem slightly off; the camera height appears more exaggerated compared to the width than specified.
issues.proposed_change: Adjust the camera's height to achieve better adherence to the specified width_height ratio.

issues.observed: Color and surface textures are not well defined, making it hard to distinguish the materials used.
issues.proposed_change: Enhance material textures and colors to match the intended palette more accurately.
issues.target: Palette of Matte Black Body, Charcoal Rubber Grip, Brushed Silver Accents, and Indicator Orange.

issues.observed: Dial placement might interfere with finger clearance.
issues.proposed_change: Reposition the dial slightly to ensure adequate clearance and alignment with the brief's specifications.
issues.target: Knurled dial requires ~1.5–2.0 mm knurl depth and 2 mm edge clearance to avoid finger rub.

metrics.method: deterministic matched-view silhouette, proportion, outline-detail and palette metrics; names and labels earn no credit

visual.summary: The rendered geometry generally aligns with the brief's specifications, showcasing the core features like the right-offset lens barrel, left-only grip, and top dials. The silhouette resembles the boxy, compact design expected for a rangefinder-style camera. However, there are issues with proportions and the clarity of materials used in the render, which detracts from the visual accuracy.

spec.subject: Compact rangefinder-style digital camera (left-grip, right-offset lens)

visual_goal.description: Boxy, compact rangefinder-style camera body with a right-offset lens barrel, a left-only rubber grip, a single prominent knurled dial and a centered hot shoe on the top plate, plus a small optical viewfinder window at the top-left of the front and a hinged I/O port door on the right side.
signature_features: Centered ISO-518 hot shoe on top plate

issues.observed: The lens barrel appears slightly misaligned and not distinctly offset to the right as per brief.
issues.proposed_change: Reposition and align the lens barrel to clearly offset it to the right of the center.

issues.observed: The presence of two dials is inconsistent with the brief.
issues.proposed_change: Remove one of the dials to maintain the single prominent dial design.

issues.observed: The viewfinder window appears slightly oversized.
issues.proposed_change: Adjust the size to better match the brief specification for an unobstructed optical viewfinder.

issues.observed: The port door is not prominently detailed.
issues.proposed_change: Add more detail to the port door to enhance visibility and functionality.

issues.observed: The grip texture lacks distinct definition.
issues.proposed_change: Enhance the texture of the grip panel to highlight its high-friction characteristic.
